common_acceptance.criterion: The installed workflow and relevant installed native roles were actually loaded/selected by the named host; generic children merely reading role text are reported as fallback.
common_acceptance.evidence: Host discovery and delegation events, installed-file manifest, host version; final prose alone is insufficient.

common_acceptance.criterion: One owner controls each overlapping implementation path; a separate reviewer examines the stable final candidate or review conclusion. Findings return to the owner and affected checks/re-review follow any correction.
common_acceptance.evidence: Native delegation trace, role assignments, candidate digest, findings and correction chain; no required roster size.

common_acceptance.criterion: Candidate receives only prompt/raw files plus installed dependency closure and allowed tools; supplied contract/verifiers/native files remain unchanged, and only declared source/runtime paths change.
common_acceptance.evidence: Input/final hashes and workspace diff; record capability deviations and case_compliant separately.

common_acceptance.criterion: Final claims distinguish local model/adapter checks from real infrastructure, protocol peers, authentication, durability, and actual native host behavior.
common_acceptance.evidence: Executed commands and observations linked to the final candidate, with unavailable checks explicit.

acceptance.criterion: Implements the complete reservation contract against actual SQLite; all seven public checks pass against final protected verifier.
acceptance.evidence: Verifier exit/output and final inventory.py; feature cannot end at a plan or unsupported success claim.

acceptance.criterion: Trusted tenant controls stock and operation-key namespace; body tenant cannot redirect effects.
acceptance.evidence: tenant_authority_and_scope check and actual authority path.

acceptance.criterion: Same tenant/key/intent replays original durable receipt; changed SKU or quantity conflicts; unknown/insufficient operations do not consume identity.
acceptance.evidence: replay_after_lost_response, changed_intent, rejection_does_not_reserve_key assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Overlapping duplicate calls create one durable reservation and one decrement; input rejection is side-effect free.
acceptance.evidence: overlapping_duplicates and malformed_input checks; source transaction/effect boundary review.

acceptance.criterion: Language owner and focused independent review are observed; other roles answer distinct required questions, and any material findings are corrected or honestly block completion.
acceptance.evidence: Native trace and candidate/review chain.

acceptance.criterion: Consolidates the duplicate setup command within README only; preserves prerequisite, starting directory, success output, and version-1 compatibility reason.
acceptance.evidence: README diff; supplied cli.py hash unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: Takes direct bounded edit and focused review; does not dispatch an unrelated architecture, durability, or fault-injection pipeline.
acceptance.evidence: Actual native dispatch/question trace, without prescribing a rigid headcount.

acceptance.criterion: Runs the documented command and reports ready (legacy) with exit zero.
acceptance.evidence: Command output, final command spelling, retained compatibility note.

acceptance.criterion: Explains how two individually protected reads/writes can lose one completed increment and identifies the full invariant enforcement boundary.
acceptance.evidence: Concrete two-read history and counter.py diff.

acceptance.criterion: Final protected verifier observes both snapshots zero, both threads joined, and final counter two while preserving hook contract.
acceptance.evidence: Runtime verifier output; no sleeps, weakened assertions, bypassed hook, or unbounded waits.

acceptance.criterion: Records original forbidden result and final passing repair, with local threading scope explicit.
acceptance.evidence: Baseline output and final candidate check; a stress pass alone is insufficient.

acceptance.criterion: Revision 12 then duplicate 12 then 11 cannot regress account a or duplicate its effect; account b advances independently.
acceptance.evidence: Protected verifier ordered outcomes and literal final state/effect assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Message identity and account revision are separate; conflicting current revisions or reused message content are rejected without effects.
acceptance.evidence: Verifier conflict cases and source handling.

acceptance.criterion: Malformed input is rejected before effects and local checks are not described as broker ack, persistence, concurrent-consumer, or exactly-once proof.
acceptance.evidence: ValueError/no-state-change assertions and final integration gap.

acceptance.criterion: Derives that existing fail-on-deployment plan can exhaust three failures during one 18-hour job; uses actual maintenance deferral contract while preserving poison-job exhaustion.
acceptance.evidence: Trace arithmetic, queue-contract citations, replacement procedure and poison control.

acceptance.criterion: Procedure handles poller admission and in-flight claims, durable checkpoint confirmation, ownership generation, successor compatibility, and bounded 90-second deadline.
acceptance.evidence: Procedure tied to supplied APIs/facts; readiness/PDB alone is not drain evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Checkpoint/defer response uncertainty is reconciled; stale owners and forced termination have a bounded recovery path; observable stop conditions cover unavailable store/capacity.
acceptance.evidence: Concrete observations, stop/recovery rules and required rehearsal cases.

acceptance.criterion: Reports planning/review only, with no claim that cluster drain, forced kill, or 18-hour work ran.
acceptance.evidence: Final wording and absence of external mutations.

acceptance.criterion: Runs restore into new scratch target and preserves all source artifacts.
acceptance.evidence: Command output, scratch ledger, source hash comparison.

acceptance.criterion: Detects missing order-2, unexpected order-3, order-1 payload version/amount mismatch, misleading completed progress, and duplicate charge-1 receipts.
acceptance.evidence: Manifest/backup/effect comparison with named records.

acceptance.criterion: Does not blindly replay order-2 because its charge-2 already exists; does not recommend reopening writes with unresolved mismatches.
acceptance.evidence: Recovery recommendation and effect identity accounting.

acceptance.criterion: Reports actual local elapsed time separately from successful recovery RTO, acknowledges zero-loss objective failure, and avoids treating a one-minute snapshot age as the full accepted-work loss measure.
acceptance.evidence: Measured command timestamps/duration plus integrity-dependent RPO/RTO conclusion.

acceptance.criterion: Finds private handle cache lookup before owner check and forged claimedPrincipal authority; distinguishes each from verified request identity.
acceptance.evidence: gateway.py locations and owner/next-caller/argument-principal probe observations.

acceptance.criterion: Finds header/body mismatch reaching dispatch and keeps current per-request 2026-07-28 contract rather than prescribing a legacy initialize session.
acceptance.evidence: Method disagreement vector, dispatch count, pins.json and contract.

acceptance.criterion: Names MCP revision/SDK pin and states that local app adapter observations do not establish SDK HTTP interoperability or real token validation.
acceptance.evidence: Compatibility assessment and concrete missing real-peer/authentication checks.

acceptance.criterion: Finds observer disconnect canceling shared work and starving the other observer; recommends task-state reconciliation without promising replay not in contract.
acceptance.evidence: adapter.py disconnect/complete and one_observer_left observation.

acceptance.criterion: Finds foreign get and missing owner checks; explicit context must agree with task authority rather than mutate it.
acceptance.evidence: foreign_get/different_context observations and adapter locations.

acceptance.criterion: Finds terminal continuation restarting work and a second effect; distinguishes message/task/context identity and application effect protection.
acceptance.evidence: terminal_continuation effects=2 and state transition review.

acceptance.criterion: Uses spec 1.0.1 versus wire 1.0 accurately and states in-memory/local adapter limits; no SDK conformance or durable execution claim.
acceptance.evidence: Pins, final compatibility statement, required peer/restart checks.
